messages:
alex: Morning — noticing increased tail latency on streaming paths after the drip scheduler tweak. partial-decode flush spikes, KV cache evictions up ~3x. anyone else seeing kernel switch churn around the 200ms mark?
morgan: yep, saw same on prod-agg. traces show kernel_selector flipping between small-kernel and full-kernel for many short streams. token-budget misestimates look likely.
jia: quick profiling: 99th +12% since rollout. KV miss rate 4% -> 12%. batch formation skewed: a lot of micro-batches size 1-2.
sam: suspect admission sampler is promoting low-priority short streams too aggressively; drip window might be too small.
alex: proposal: soft-priority smoothing — hold short streams up to 8ms to allow coalescing, but flush immediately on newline or stream-complete.
jia: tried a quick local config, results promising. config snippet: ```json
{
  "drip_hold_ms": 8,
  "priority_smooth": "soft",
  "partial_decode_delay_ms": 3,
  "token_budget_bias": -0.15
}
```
morgan: local run: 99th down ~6%, KV miss down ~30%, but single-token completions latency slightly up.
sam: tradeoff seems okay if we add a hard fallback: if partial-decode backlog > 64, force flush.
alex: also add a kernel hint: prefer small-kernel when batch token count < 64 or when stream was coalesced from single-request chunks.
jia: queued a canary: infra/rollouts#482. plan A/B tomorrow 06:00 UTC for 2h.
perf-bot: canary deployed to 10% on prod-edge (rollout id r482). dashboards: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/rollouts/482
morgan: will flip log-level for kernel_selector transitions on 1% sample and attach traces to the canary.
alex: @sam can you own rollback criteria? propose: 99th latency increase >5% for 5m OR KV miss >8% sustained.
sam: ack. setting alerts + slack page. :white_check_mark:
jia: one more tweak: if drip_hold_ms > 0, bump KV prefetch window to avoid cold misses during hold.
morgan: good call.
alex: thanks team — will post perf graphs and raw traces here after the canary run. :rocket:
